propositions: git fetch of the GitHub mirror intermittently hangs past 300s timeout due to established but stalled connections having no throughput-keyed abort mechanism
stalled fetch (connection accepted, zero bytes sent) should abort in ~10 seconds using http.lowSpeedLimit and http.lowSpeedTime git config rather than burning full 300s wall-clock timeout
legitimately slow but progressing fetches (sustained throughput above configured floor) must not be aborted by the low-speed mechanism
transient low-speed abort failures should be retried in-process a bounded number of times (worst case ~30s) while non-low-speed failures (auth, bad ref) should not be retried
git-subprocess and fetch-locking code cluster must move from repo_snapshot.py (788 LOC) to new git_fetch.py sibling to stay under 800 LOC module-size cap
